description: Senders, receivers and immovable operation-state lifetimes

expected.contract: Complete before start is INVALID. Start then stop leaves STARTED with cancellation requested. Complete CANCELLED,3 invokes one receiver and reaches DONE. Duplicate complete on a still-live test state is INVALID and leaves callback count1. A separate heap-owned completion test frees the state inside its receiver without later access.
